## Dosing

* Pocket volume (computed from the wheel solid, incl. fillets): **10.48 ml** (sharp-edged sector solid: 10.39 ml)
* Grams per pocket at 0.65 g/ml: **6.81 g**
* Dose 10 g -> 1 pockets = 6.8 g  (60 deg of wheel rotation)
* Dose 20 g -> 3 pockets = 20.4 g  (180 deg of wheel rotation)
* Dose 40 g -> 6 pockets = 40.9 g  (360 deg of wheel rotation)
* Pocket mouth (tangential) = 36.0 mm = 7.2 x pellet diameter (requirement >= 3x); axial width 22 mm = 4.4x
* Wheel-to-housing clearance: radial 0.7 mm, axial 0.7 mm (crest fillet 1.5 mm)

## Hopper

* Usable capacity up to the fill line: **1200 ml** = 780 g of pellets (funnel 274 ml + cylinder 117.9 mm); total to the rim 1388 ml
* Days of food at 40 g/day (2 x 20 g): **19.5 days**; at the default 2 x 20 g/day: 19.5 days; at 2 x 10 g/day: 39.0 days
* Mouth inner diameter 100 mm (>= 90); funnel wall slopes +X 70.4 deg, -X 60.5 deg, +-Y 62.8 deg (all >= 60 deg from horizontal)

## Bowl

* Inner diameter at brim **140 mm**, inner depth **45 mm**, spherical dish radius 76.9 mm
* Volume to the brim: **394 ml**; volume below the low front rim: 78 ml (a 40 g dose = 62 ml)
* Front (rabbit-facing) rim height 32 mm above the ground; back/side rim 58 mm
* Base diameter 168 mm = 1.20 x bowl diameter (>= 1.2); steel weight plate 106 x 3.2 mm = 222 g
